A '''''Nu''-class attack Transport '''was captured by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], being used to help load [[Rhydonium/Legends|Rhydonium]] explosives from [[Abafar/Legends|Abafar]] to the captured cruiser ''[[Renown/Legends|Renown]]'' as part of a [[Carida Incident|terrorist plot]]. It was eventually stolen by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[D-Squad/Legends|D-Squad]] during their [[Escape from Abafar/Legends|escape from Abafar]].
